name: CoolTime
cover:
Holiday sales
are here.
How's your wallet?

features.label: Why it happens
features.headline:
The urge fades.
The receipt doesn't
features.text:
Most impulse buys feel less urgent
a few days later. We just don't wait.

features.label: Put a cooldown on it
features.headline:
Like a skill
in a game
features.text:
Shopping, takeout, desserts. Pick how long
to wait before you can use it again.

features.label: Breaking it?
features.headline:
One more pause
before you pay
features.text:
It shows the time left and warns that
your compliance rate will drop.

features.label: Bonus
features.headline:
See what
waiting saved you
features.text:
Compliance by item and category,
plus your estimated savings this month.

outro:
Want it now?
Wait it out first
points: Time left on Home and Lock Screen widgets
Records stay on your iPhone, no account
